svg.title: E-commerce incremental ELT data platform: architecture and data flow
svg.desc: Local Docker Compose runtime. Airflow orchestrates a Python generator, validation, and loader into PostgreSQL raw tables, then dbt builds staging views, an intermediate view, and incremental marts, followed by dbt tests.
svg.text: Local architecture and data flow: Python, PostgreSQL 16, dbt Core, Apache Airflow 2.10
Retries and reruns are orchestration behavior (Airflow)
